prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a small transparent animated icon on a fashion workflow website
Primary request: Create a square source sheet with EXACTLY four equal panels in an exact 2x2 arrangement. Show the SAME softly sculpted premium white-clay miniature tailored jacket repeated in four successive phases of pattern grading: three subtle nested outline layers of this identical jacket expand smoothly outward to represent smaller, middle, and larger sizes. Phase 1: outlines close together. Phase 2: outer silhouette expands slightly. Phase 3: three graded silhouettes are clearly separated by a small even step. Phase 4: they settle back toward the first position. Keep one jacket design and maintain symmetry and proportions. Clearly communicate garment size grading.
Scene/backdrop: transparent.
Subject: a centered, finely detailed jacket silhouette with two or three softly embossed overlapping size outlines.
Style/medium: charming premium softly rounded white-clay/paper 3D miniature fashion icon; matte white surfaces and pale neutral-grey dimensional shading, tasteful and sophisticated, hand-finished, not crude line art.
Composition/framing: fixed camera, identical camera scale, centered jacket, same lighting and margins in every equal square tile; exact 2x2 with no visible dividers; fit all size layers inside each tile.
Lighting/mood: soft clean studio light with subtle dimensional shadows.
Color palette: white and pale neutral-grey only with transparent alpha.
Materials/textures: fine matte porcelain-like clay with subtle paper-like seam details.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: exactly four panels, same recognizable jacket in every tile; only gradual outward size spacing changes, no design drift; transparent background.
Avoid: other garments, people, hangers, arrows, labels, text, numerals, colors, beige, black background, watermark, grid, borders, gaps, cropped silhouettes, camera changes, flat vector styling.
